intro.heading: Õnnitust!
cert.blurb: See sertifikaat kinnitab, et Global IQ Test on lõppenud. IQ-punkti on kognitsusvõime mõõtmine, mis põhineb testide vastustel.
share.heading: Ütle oma tulemused
share.sub: Las inimesed teavad, kuidas sa tegid.
note.text: Sinu tulemuste kohta. GlobalIQ is designed for educational and entertainment purposes. It is not a clinical assessment, it is not administered by a licensed psychologist, and it should not be used for employment, academic placement, or medical decisions. Results vary with tiredness, environment, and familiarity with the question format.
